title.narrative: Environmentally Sound Management and Final Disposal of Polychlorinated Biphenyls (PCBs)

description.narrative: The proposed project will establish an environmentally sound management (ESM) system for PCBs, improve compliance to PCBs related obligations under the Stockholm Convention (SC) and promote local use of noncombustion technologies in the disposal of all PCBs identified during the preliminary inventory of the National Implementation Plan (NIP).
